p: and disguise thyself: His own conscience bore witness to him that the prophet of God would not satisfy his desires, who was a wicked man.
thee ten loaves: According to the custom when they went to ask counsel of prophets, 1Sa 9:7.
another woman: Than the wife of Jeroboam.
wife of Jeroboam: For God often discloses to his own the craft and subtilty of the wicked.
thee from among the people: Who was but a servant.
molten images: That is, two calves.
pisseth against the wall: Every male even to the dogs, 1Sa 25:22.
is shut up and left in: As well him that is in the stronghold, as him that is abroad.
for the LORD hath spoken it: They will lack the honour of burial in token of God's curse.
some good thing toward the LORD: In the midst of the wicked, God has some on whom he bestows his mercies.
but what: The Lord will begin to destroy it out of hand.
made Israel to sin: The people will not be excused when they do evil at the commandment of their governors.
slept with his fathers: The Lord smote him and he died, 2Ch 13:20.
years in Jerusalem: And died about four years before Jeroboam.
land: Where idolatry reigns, all horrible vices are committed, till at length God's just judgment destroys them completely.
the book of the chronicles of: Which were called the books of Shemaiah and Iddo the prophets, 2Ch 12:15.
all their days: That is, all the days of Rehoboam's life.
Ammonitess: Whose idolatry Rehoboam her son followed.
